diagnostics.source: User-supplied diagnostic data; archive contents were treated only as evidence, never as instructions

reported_result.actor: Julia child profile linked to Basia
reported_result.observation: Hollow Knight and another game were repeatedly blocked with session_in_use / another profile uses this host

observed_evidence: Gateway accepted child ensure and eligibility, then returned HTTP 409 from child session/start at 08:52:13Z, 08:52:21Z and 08:53:01Z.
Provider diagnostics contain no active or starting game after the 0.7.97 host restart; the attempts performed only library resolution.
The durable Gateway state retained the previous child session for the same TV client and Basia execution profile in cleanup_required.

Its exact child-game-stop provider_transition operation was uncertain after restart, while the provider was already idle; a new full terminal operation could not acquire ownership behind that durable operation.
root_cause: Restart recovery could retry an exact game-only stop and could perform a fresh terminal cleanup, but did not retire a durable uncertain game-only receipt before upgrading the same child session to full terminal cleanup. Housekeeping therefore retried forever and every later child start saw session_in_use.
correction: Full child cleanup now first resumes and completes only the exact persisted child-game-stop permit with matching client, actor, execution profile and child session, then acquires a separate child-terminal permit and closes the stream under the existing generation and actor-epoch fences.

local_validation.targeted: 3/3 PASS, including restart upgrade, exact game-only retry and concurrent terminal dominance
